title: CVE-Factory: Scaling Expert-Level Agentic Tasks for Code Security Vulnerability

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing empirical success rates of automated vulnerability repair across 14 programming languages (e.g., PHP, JavaScript, Python, C) and analyzing whether performance gaps stem from language-intrinsic difficulty or differences in task/CWE composition.
Comparing model performance and success rates on AI/ML-related vulnerabilities versus Web-related vulnerabilities, while controlling for the underlying vulnerability (CWE) category composition.

Evaluating success rates of CVEs sourced from GitHub versus non-GitHub platforms to identify if apparent performance advantages are driven by repository conventions or underlying sample biases in task complexity.
